name.markdownDescription:
Display Name

Optional friendly name shown in Home Assistant. If not set, uses effective_id.
name.title: Name

id.markdownDescription:
Output ID

Technical identifier used in MQTT topics, output groups, and actions.
- If boneio_output is set: id is optional (defaults to boneio_output)
- If boneio_output is NOT set: id is REQUIRED
- If both are set: id overrides boneio_output as identifier
id.title: Id

boneio_output.markdownDescription:
BoneIO Output

Reference to predefined output configuration (e.g., OUT_01, OUT_02).
Available only when 'boneio' section is configured.
Used as default ID if 'id' field is not specified.
boneio_output.title: Boneio output

area.markdownDescription:
Area/Room

Reference to area ID defined in 'areas' section.
Creates a sub-device linked to the main BoneIO device.
area.title: Area

momentary_turn_on.description: How long can this relay be on. Can't be used if output_type is "none".
momentary_turn_on.title: Momentary turn on

momentary_turn_off.description: How long can this relay be off. Can't be used if output_type is "none".
momentary_turn_off.title: Momentary turn off

adjustable_duration.description: Enable an HA number entity (slider) to dynamically set the on-timer. When ON is pressed, auto-OFF after this duration.
adjustable_duration.title: Adjustable duration

duration_unit.description: Unit displayed on Home Assistant duration slider.
duration_unit.title: Duration unit

interlock_group.markdownDescription:
Interlock group name or list

Assigns this output to a software interlock group (or groups). Outputs with the same group name cannot be active at the same time.
You can provide a single group name (string) or a list of names (if the output should belong to multiple groups).
interlock_group.title: Interlock group

percentage_default_brightness.description: When the brightness is not set in ha, and we switch led to turn this value will be used
percentage_default_brightness.title: Percentage default brightness

output_type.description: Taken from the board when boneio_output names an output it maps; required otherwise. If HA discovery is used device if relay is light or switch. Cover if this output will be used for cover. If None is declared then any state is not published to MQTT (used for cover).
output_type.title: Output type
